{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, verify that all non-999999.99 values are valid numbers
print("Unique revenue values (excluding 999999.99):", df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']['revenue'].unique()[:20])

df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm that the conversion worked and that there are no hidden issues
print("Min and max revenue (numeric):", df['revenue_numeric'].min(), df['revenue_numeric'].max())

# Check for any remaining 999999.99 values after conversion
print("Number of rows with revenue_numeric == 999999.99:", (df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
